note: Fulton County PA does not zone (Pennsylvania counties generally do not). The only municipal zoning found is McConnellsburg Borough's, published as a 1995 PDF ordinance with an official zoning map adopted by reference, not a queryable polygon service. The county GIS (fulco.maps.arcgis.com web map, 6b059a8e4032488c98b3f882e131ae00) has parcels, flood zones, soils, municipal boundaries and no zoning layer. The county planning office says GIS data must be requested from its office. No ArcGIS REST zoning layer found in searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online, PASDA, or county pages.
